headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 7, 2026**
article:
The Milwaukee Brewers secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals in a close game, with Jacob Misiorowski pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 11. Abner Uribe earned the save in the final. The Brewers also dominated the Cardinals in a 10-2 victory, led by Robert Gasser's 7.2 innings pitched and 4 strikeouts.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Marco Raya, a right-hander for the Minnesota Twins, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement, effective retroactive to July 5, 2026. Other players on the injured list include Endy Rodríguez (Pittsburgh Pirates), Lou Trivino III (Philadelphia Phillies), Jonah Cox (San Francisco Giants), Austin Warren (New York Mets), Byron Buxton (Minnesota Twins), Konnor Griffin (Pittsburgh Pirates), and David Hamilton (Milwaukee Brewers).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The New York Mets acquired Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash, while the Tigers traded Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, and the Houston Astros traded Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Brewers Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a hard-fought win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Misiorowski pitching 7.0 innings, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Abner Uribe earned the save in the close 4-3 final.

top_news.title: **Brewers Blast Past Cardinals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers dominated the St. Louis Cardinals, securing a 10-2 victory. Robert Gasser led the Brewers' pitching effort with 7.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Matthew Boyd earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall to Tigers in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers took down the Athletics 6-2, securing a win behind a strong outing from Tarik Skubal. Skubal pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Giants 10-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants in a lopsided 10-0 victory. Impact hitters for the Blue Jays included Nathan Lukes, Vladimir Guerrero Jr., George Springer, Daulton Varsho, and Kazuma Okamoto.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Marco Raya Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-hander Marco Raya has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right shoulder impingement, effective retroactive to July 5, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers for cash.
